title: timeline core model and undo

commit.merge_subject: merge: timeline core model and undo

description:
TL-07: cut/move/trim/duplicate/delete as transactions with
exact undo. Command pattern (documented in the file KDoc):
each edit is an immutable TimelineEdit with apply() and
inverse() — the inverse is built against the PRE-edit project
(captured by the history at apply time), so undo restores the
precise pre-edit state, ids included. Snapshot history was
rejected because transactions restore the exact old clip
where a snapshot diff would tempt "restore the range but
renumber", which the ID STABILITY rule forbids.

Transactions: AddClip, RemoveClip, MoveClip, DuplicateClip,
TrimClip, SplitClip (with caller-minted right ids incl. the
linked-audio right piece, so undo can address every piece),
SetOutput, SetClipColor. Internal RestoreSplit/RestoreTrim
carry the exact undo state; redo re-applies the stored
ORIGINAL transaction, never a recomputed inverse-of-inverse.

TimelineOps adds trimRes
